args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia's coastal account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living, or the supervisor searches twice.
- "PHL" is also shared with Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on PHL returns both businesses. Use the full name.

Drafted by assistant for Sofia Marchetti.
